title: Warp product trio
description: A mono title with a brand-blue lead, then three product cards joined in one hairline-framed row: a big square image on top, a geometric semibold name, a muted mono line and an action — a full-width ink button, or a command box with a copy icon and a 'Mac | Linux | Windows' switch under it. Phones stack the cards.
notes: the platform switch and copy button use React state, so it needs hydrate
each image is a media slot (a dotted placeholder while empty)
name: warp-everywhere
